title: Cereal Bar: what is usually in it
standfirst: The names most often on these labels, and how much the packs differ.

spans.text: These are the names that come up most often on labels in this group. Not every pack has them. A pack can also name things this list does not.
Some of these turn a plan on. Each one has its own page saying which plan, and what we look for. This is how the app reads a label, not advice.

resolved.method: Per 100 g, across the packs in this group that print a sugar figure, sorted low to high. This is the pack 10 per cent of the way from lowest to highest.
resolved.excludedNote: Packs here that print no sugar figure are not counted — a missing number is not a zero.
resolved.limit: A group can hold very different foods, and this says nothing about the pack in your hand. It describes what we hold, not everything on sale.
